_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: sentiment/momentum at 63 with flat funding leaves the tape in-band Hope unless heat or a vol/flow shock appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION in Hope; narrative only flags rising OKX aggressive buys without a forward phase/direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~55-70, funding stays near flat, and 30d momentum remains well below mini-top heat
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding and 30d momentum spike toward mini-top levels, or a vol/flow shock with funding flipping negative knocks the score out of the Hope band
